question: Can local historical capitalization supply a time-aligned industry size control for existing diffusion versus price comparisons?
scope: data construction and coverage, no return evaluation or fitted model in this round
source: EP32 extension_v2 monthly stock panel raw_close * total_shares; effective_date <= date but known_at absent
membership: prior-month identity records from original assignments and EP35 L1; current observation month exact-date stock cap; retain every identified member in denominator
feature: median natural log positive finite total market cap of currently listed valid stocks; >=5 known stocks and >=80% member coverage; otherwise missing; no forward fills
quality: Historical-proxy; no strict PIT certification; L1 historical parent mapping proxy inherited
value_boundary: existing PE historical percentile is valuation-position control, not book-to-market; no complete style-risk attribution claim
verification: no future cap/share dates; source cap equality raw price times shares; duplicate identity rejection; direct membership/median recomputation; common price/diffusion coverage only, no outcome selection
next_gate: if enough coverage, separately preregister identical-cohort F / FD / F+size / FD+size annual model comparisons; fixed original labels and training rules
